org_research:
Operating Engineers Local Union No. 3 — Political Action Committee Questionnaire, Form 594 revised 8/19/2025. Five pages, 97 fillable fields. Questions transcribed from the PDF text layer, verbatim.

FORM RULES. The candidate must complete every part, and a PHYSICAL address is required — the Secretary of State no longer accepts P.O. boxes. "No endorsement or contribution will be considered if incomplete." The district office must receive the completed form in advance of the next PAC meeting before the candidate is placed on the PAC agenda.

FLAG — the form assumes a PAC contribution is possible. Berkeley's Election Reform Act bars corporate, business and union contributions outright, bars PAC contributions entirely, and caps every contribution at $60 per donor. The final question asks the candidate to rank whether get-out-the-vote, printing, or a monetary contribution would help most; the monetary option is not available to a publicly financed Berkeley candidate. Worth answering directly rather than leaving blank.
